title: Decision: a malformed did_webvh_heads fails closed; decode limits
description:
draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00 §The Heads Extension defines DIDWebVHHeads but no size limits, and does not say what a member does with a malformed extension (unsorted, duplicate scid, keys not 32 bytes or not sorted).

AGENTS.md says untrusted extensions get caps and a malformed one is dropped without failing the containing object. Here the extension decides membership, so dropping it would silently forget revocations.

Chosen: a malformed did_webvh_heads fails closed: the Commit, Welcome or GroupInfo is refused. Decoding enforces: strictly ascending scid bytes (so unique), strictly ascending 32-byte keys, ASCII scid (<=46 bytes) and version_id (<=67 bytes, starting with a version number without a leading zero), at most MAX_HEADS = 65,536 entries (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC; the record grows forever, open issue 6) and at most MAX_AUTHORIZED_KEYS = 1,048,576/48 keys per head (derived: each distinct key needs a >=48-byte publicKeyMultibase string in a <=1 MiB document, so no valid log exceeds it). crates/mls-didwebvh/src/heads.rs. For -01: say malformed means reject, and consider a limit on heads or say none is intended.
close_reason: Chosen by agent per the reading in the description; recorded in docs/didwebvh-draft-feedback.md for -01; flag to Mark
